title.zh: 雨窗速写本：你会画下哪一层？

description.en: Six visual framing choices about a window’s foreground, reflections and the distant scene. Find the illustrated view your sketchbook keeps.
description.zh: 六次视觉取景选择，围绕窗前物、玻璃倒影与远处景象，看看速写本会留下哪一层画面。

introduction.en: Imagine making a small sketch from indoors while illustrated rain crosses the window. You choose a frame and what to leave outside it. This is a drawing game, with no need to judge your real artistic skill or look into anybody else’s private space.
introduction.zh: 想象在室内速写，插画雨丝划过窗面。你选择取景，也选择什么留在画框外。这是绘画小游戏，不评判真实画技，也无需看进他人私人空间。

focus.en: Framing a layered picture by focusing on nearby objects, reflections or the view beyond the glass.
focus.zh: 面对分层画面，把焦点放在近处物件、倒影或玻璃之外的景象。

prompt.en: Your first sketch has room for one main subject. You choose…
prompt.zh: 第一幅速写只留一个主要对象，你选……

label.en: A cup and plant on the inner windowsill.
label.zh: 内窗台的一只杯子与植物。

label.en: The room reflected faintly over the glass.
label.zh: 玻璃上淡淡叠出的房间倒影。

label.en: The line of rooftops beyond the rain.

prompt.en: A raindrop crosses the picture. You…

label.en: Use it to separate the reflected room from the outer view.
label.zh: 用它分开房间倒影与外面景象。

label.en: Keep it as a small mark beside the sill object.
label.zh: 把它当窗台物件旁的小笔迹。

label.en: Let it partly blur a distant line.
label.zh: 让它稍稍模糊远处的一条线。

prompt.en: The sketch feels crowded. You remove…
prompt.zh: 速写看起来太满，你先去掉……

label.en: Indoor details so the far view has more space.
label.zh: 室内细节，给远景更多空间。

label.en: Most of the outer view so the close subject stands out.
label.zh: 大部分外景，让近处对象突出。

label.en: Strong outlines that hide the overlapping layers.
label.zh: 遮住叠层关系的过强轮廓。

prompt.en: You can add one small color accent. It goes on…
prompt.zh: 可加一点颜色，你把它放在……

label.en: The edge of the familiar cup beside you.
A reflected lamp that appears to float over the view.
label.zh: 仿佛浮在景象上的灯倒影。

label.en: A tiny distant shape that anchors the whole frame.
label.zh: 锚住整个画框的一点远处形状。

prompt.en: A second page lets you change the frame. You…
prompt.zh: 第二页允许换一种取景，你会……

label.en: Show how two layers occupy the same patch of glass.
label.zh: 画出两层如何占着同一片玻璃。

label.en: Crop closer to an ordinary object you know well.
label.zh: 更近地裁出一个熟悉日常物件。

label.en: Widen the outer view and reduce the window frame.
label.zh: 扩大外景，缩小窗框比例。

prompt.en: What title fits your favorite finished page?
prompt.zh: 给最喜欢的成品页取标题，你选……

label.zh: 一片玻璃里的两个空间。

summary.en: Your page stays close to the cup, plant and familiar edge beside you. Rain becomes a setting around an ordinary subject rather than the whole event. This ending describes your selected frame, not a preference for staying indoors in every part of life.
summary.zh: 你的纸页停在杯子、植物与身边熟悉边缘。雨成为日常对象周围的背景，不必独占事件。结局描述所选画框，不推断你在人生各处都偏爱待在室内。

example.en: You might sketch the corner of a reading table with one favorite object, letting the rest of the room remain a few loose lines.
example.zh: 你可能画阅读桌一角的一件喜欢物品，让房间其余部分只留下几条松线。

strength.en: A nearby ordinary subject makes a short drawing session approachable and lets small relationships of placement carry the picture.
strength.zh: 近处日常对象让短速写容易开始，也让细小位置关系撑起画面。

tradeoff.en: A tight crop can leave out the setting that gives an object its particular mood. One wider page may offer another useful reading.
tradeoff.zh: 紧裁可能省掉赋予物件氛围的环境。再画一张稍宽画面，也许会有另一种读法。

experiment.en: Draw one object already beside you twice: once very close, once with a little context. Notice which frame you enjoy today without turning it into a rule.
experiment.zh: 画身旁已有物件两次：一次很近，一次带点环境。看看今天喜欢哪种，不必把它变成规则。

summary.en: Your window holds two views at once. A reflected room and an outer scene can overlap without needing one to disappear. The ending follows your interest in visual layers within this drawing game, not a claim that you see hidden truths.
summary.zh: 你的窗面同时留住两幅景象。房间倒影与外景可以叠着，不必先让一方消失。结局跟随绘画游戏中的分层兴趣，不宣称你能看穿隐藏真相。

example.en: In a collage, you might place a translucent scrap over a printed shape and enjoy the third image that their overlap creates.
example.zh: 做拼贴时，你可能把半透明纸片叠在印刷形状上，欣赏重合后出现的第三幅图。

strength.en: Layering can connect otherwise separate elements and give a modest picture depth without needing a large number of objects.
strength.zh: 叠层能连接原本分开的元素，让小画面有深度，不必塞进大量物件。

tradeoff.en: Too many overlapping layers can make the picture difficult to read. Keeping one clear edge can help another viewer find a starting point.
tradeoff.zh: 叠层过多也会难读。留一条清楚边缘，能帮其他观者找到起点。

experiment.en: Try one simple two-layer collage using materials you already have. Keep one part uncovered so both the layers and their overlap remain visible.
experiment.zh: 用已有材料试一张简单双层拼贴。留一部分不覆盖，让各层与重叠处都可见。

summary.en: Your sketch reaches through the window toward a broader view. A distant line or tiny accent anchors the page while the room becomes a frame. This is a visual choice made here, not a declaration that you always seek distant horizons.
summary.zh: 你的速写穿过窗面，伸向较宽景象。远线或小色点锚住纸页，房间退成画框。这是本次视觉选择，不宣称你总在追逐远方。

example.en: From an ordinary public viewpoint, you might sketch the broad skyline first and use just a small foreground corner to show where you were standing.
example.zh: 从普通公共观景点，你可能先画大轮廓，只用一小块前景说明自己站在哪里。

strength.en: A broader frame can make the relationship between separate shapes visible and give a small distant detail a place within a whole composition.
strength.zh: 较宽画框让不同形状的关系可见，也让一个远处小细节在完整构图里有位置。

tradeoff.en: A distant subject can become generic if the close framing is removed entirely. One nearby reference may make the view more particular.
tradeoff.zh: 若近处取景全被删去，远景可能变得泛泛。一个身边参照能让视野更具体。

experiment.en: Sketch a familiar wide view with one nearby reference included. Change only the crop on a second page and compare what the two frames emphasize.
experiment.zh: 画一幅熟悉广景，留一个近处参照。第二页只改裁切，比较两种画框各突出什么。
